quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Announces Extension of Expiration Date of Exchange (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Qorvo merger financing: Skyworks further extended the expiration date and withdrawal deadline of its exchange offers for Qorvo's 4.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and 3.375% Senior Notes due 2031 (into up to $850,000,000 and up to $700,000,000 of new Skyworks notes) to 5:00 p.m. New York City time on September 25, 2026. As of September 18, 2026, $775,664,000 (91.25%) of the $850,000,000 outstanding 2029 notes and $653,328,000 (93.33%) of the $700,000,000 outstanding 2031 notes had been validly tendered. Merger timing: Skyworks is hopeful that the Mergers (Qorvo merging into a wholly-owned Skyworks subsidiary) will close within the calendar year, subject to closing conditions, and is preparing to close as early as within the fiscal year, but says there can be no assurances on that timeline. The exchange offers are conditioned on the merger closing; the merger is not conditioned on the exchange offers.
quarterly_data.figure: $775,664,000 (91.25%) of 2029 notes and $653,328,000 (93.33%) of 2031 notes tendered; merger close hoped within the calendar year
